authority.interpretation: This file indexes the complete 95-route history through its authoritative ledger and makes the Epoch 7 category boundaries explicit. It does not broaden any scoped negative result into a field-wide claim.

scientifically_closed_methods.scope: fixed photometric-transform ensemble on its frozen SmolVLA two-task panel
agentview-as-wrist fill under persistent wrist dropout
mechanism-faithful A2C2 local port v1 on its frozen panel; not the official paper method
historical low-compute TCA/ActionMap target-conditioned heatmap route
each route is closed only at the exact formulation and frozen evidence recorded in the complete history audit

closed_problem_axes.scope: claim-defining wrist-camera dropout method development in this campaign; not missing-view robotics in general
local asynchronous-inference-delay thesis on the frozen official-semantics panel; not all timing research
unbounded natural-reset identity mining; controlled new conditions remain open

reusable_negative_evidence: completed Stage B closures show that many small post-hoc action filters, residuals, memories, and visual transforms lose to Base or simple controls
BR-XVLA and MPR-XVLA show that hand-designed phase or object weighting must beat a matched uniform-adaptation control
wrist reconstruction quality alone did not produce a practically meaningful action-semantic advantage
natural-reset residual mining often saturates under a stronger second prior or lacks legal headroom
offline action distance or representation quality cannot substitute for official closed-loop success
